items.title: Sumner Labat Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: He gave you one lesson... And he was showing me how the sandlers go, blues go, you know. And he showed me how the fingers and whatnot.

ctx.x: I used to always tell us. In fact, Uncle Buddy, we used to call him Uncle Buddy. He's named Buddy Johnson. And Yank, he used to come out when Buddy couldn't come meet son Yank, I tell you see.
Well, what was the clarinet player's name? Joe Watson. Joe Watson. Joe Watson. Sweet clarinet player, too. What? Yeah, sweet clarinet player.
